basic_details.job_title: GU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Gauhati University, Guwahati, needs two Junior Research Fellows (JRF) for a joint research project of Gauhati University and IIT Madras, Chennai, funded by Monsoon Mission-III, Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology under the Ministry of Earth Sciences. The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + HRA (as per MoES norms), initially for one year and extendable up to three years. Indian nationals with an M.Sc./M.Tech. in Atmospheric Science, Physics, Meteorology or other listed disciplines (at least 55% marks; 50% for SC/ST/OBC as applicable) can apply by email to [email protected] by 30 November 202

qualification.details: M.Sc./M.Tech. Atmospheric Science, Applied Physics, Physics, Meteorology, Climate Science, Oceanography, Geophysics, Geology or other relevant disciplines with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC as applicable). Demonstrated knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the following topics: Knowledge and understanding of weather and climate phenomena like the Indian monsoon and El Nino and Southern Oscillations Scientific programming using Python Processing and analysis of weather and climate datasets, including CMIP6, ERA5, IMD datasets or similar Development and implementation of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning models for scientific applications Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP), climate modelling or related computational techniques

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from eligible Indian nationals. Both posts carry the same eligibility. M.Sc./M.Tech. Atmospheric Science, Applied Physics, Physics, Meteorology, Climate Science, Oceanography, Geophysics, Geology or other relevant disciplines with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC as applicable). Demonstrated knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the following topics: Knowledge and understanding of weather and climate phenomena like the Indian monsoon and El Nino and Southern Oscillations Scientific programming using Python Processing and analysis of weather and climate datasets, including CMIP6, ERA5, IMD datasets or similar Development and implementation of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning models for scientific applications Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP), climate modelling or related computational techniques Publications or project experience in relevant areas. The notice does not mention an age limit, although proof of age must be sent with the application. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + HRA, with the HRA paid as per MoES norms. The appointments are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The positions are initially for one year and are extendable up to three years based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: Gauhati University Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will work in an interdisciplinary research environment involving weather and climate science, and Artificial Intelligence. Responsibilities will include: Contributing to achieving the objectives of the Project by working with the Project Associates. Processing and analysis of weather and climate datasets. Processing CMIP6, ERA5, IMD and other meteorological datasets. Development, training and validation of AI/ML models for rainfall and monsoon prediction. Climate model evaluation and scientific data analysis. Scientific programming and software development using Python. Assistance in project documentation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gauhati University Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email only; the notice gives no application form or postal route. Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Attach the documents named in the notice (listed below). Send the email to [email protected] . Mark a CC to [email protected] . Write the subject line as: Application for Junior Research Fellow . Send the application by 30 November 2026. Detailed Curriculum Vitae Copies of educational certificates and mark sheets Proof of age Experience certificates (if any) List of publications (for PDF applicants) Other relevant supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: For queries, the notice prints the university's office telephone 0361 - 2570 415 and fax 91-0361-2700 311. The office address is Gauhati University, Gopinath Bordoloi Nagar, Guwahati - 781 014, Assam, India.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow vacancies has Gauhati University announced?

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Gauhati University JRF posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Gauhati University JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc./M.Tech. in Atmospheric Science, Applied Physics, Physics, Meteorology, Climate Science, Oceanography, Geophysics, Geology or other relevant disciplines with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC as applicable), plus demonstrated knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the listed topics.

faq.question: Q4. What is the fellowship for the Gauhati University JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + HRA (as per MoES norms).

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹37,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid in addition to ₹37,000 per month, as per MoES norms.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Gauhati University JRF posts?
faq.answer: Email your detailed CV, copies of educational certificates and mark sheets, proof of age, experience certificates (if any) and other supporting documents to [email protected] with CC to [email protected] by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?

faq.question: Q8. How will the Gauhati University JRFs be selected?

faq.question: Q9. Is the Gauhati University JRF a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointments are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, initially for one year and extendable up to three years based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds.
